svg.title: Workflow, decisions and content on one platform
svg.desc: Three parts of Cloud Pak for Business Automation on one line. Workflow: tasks in a row, automated from first task to fully executed work. Decisions: a decision with two branches, business policies turned into decisions and tested first. Content: governed documents and a folder, captured, managed and governed with AI-powered classification and extraction. One light is lit on the decision.
